'''Scarabs''' are higher levelled versions of [[scarab swarms]], which, like their lower level counterparts, are capable of poisoning, and attack extremely fast (once every [[game tick]], or 0.6 seconds) and almost always cause damage, making them dangerous for lower levelled players.

They randomly spawn inside the [[Jaldraocht Pyramid]], spawning when a crack appears on the ground and emerging from it. 

Killing scarabs is a possible task from a Menaphos [[City Quest]]. Fighting the mummies in the pyramid is one way to get them to spawn.
